designStatus: Original untested source-fit protocols; no learner observations

checks: Use a varied purposeful movement/game portfolio and a separate fine-control making/digit-production task; assess balance, coordination, flexibility and suitably sustained carrying/walking/running directly.
The broad goal requires an integrated everyday transfer, not just adding child-code Full labels. Component links do not certify general fitness or all physical activities.
Actually walk/run, hop, alternate skips and jump/land under control with direction/stop changes; use suitable object-control cases for purposeful throws, catches and kicks.
Retain the full new-card requirements, including changed cases and movement into an object-control action. Verbal force/motion knowledge is not a substitute.
For sustained hopping retain the declared source-specific period/task; do not collapse it into one successful hop or import a fixed universal cutoff.
Hold and change a safe base of support, transfer weight and move/turn on a floor route with controlled recovery.
Include actual controlled flexibility/mobility within a suitable preparation sequence. Climbing/cycling illustrations do not create mandatory named-sport knowledge or high-apparatus tasks.
The faster-movement source case must include real controlled balance at changed speed, not only a still pose.
Retain the complete existing craft card: accurate card/fabric cutting, folding/rolling/shaping, choosing a secure moving/standing join, safe use and storage.
Add a legible digit-production case with the complete existing 0–9 card; no universal mastery of the English 26-letter inventory is inferred.
These are actual precision/control tasks; they do not mark all twenty detailed suggestive fine-motor positions reviewed or require every learner to use a specified dominant hand.
Use a suitably demanding safe carried-object task and purposeful sustained walking/running/hopping as the applicable record requires. Record the task, load, duration, pauses and access conditions.
Observe control, appropriate effort and completion rather than equating a sprint or maximum lift with strength/endurance. The complete hopping-game condition stays intact.
These are retained source performance duties, not a new binary body-capacity score or fixed cross-country physical norm. No actual child performance is claimed in this design.
Actually coordinate hopping/skipping with a suitable rope and a safe clear space. A rope-free gait alone does not account for this source position.
Use the complete locomotor/balance tasks separately; the rope is a source-required coordination condition in this protocol, not a new grade/difficulty-level topic.

Provide the printed single-leg position with the other leg folded and retain its 60-second condition in the selected source case. Record the actual support/access conditions and performance when assessment occurs.
The complete generic balance card is assessed independently. Failure to perform or access this source case cannot be erased by a shorter still pose or converted into a general body-fitness label.

Use an appropriate local modified game or station sequence requiring actual running/jumping and receiving/sending/striking/kicking objects. Combine movement with a purposeful object action rather than test only static vocabulary.
Retain the complete contributing new-card evidence, changed cases and appropriate safe materials. A single lucky impact or unvaried drill does not establish the whole operation.
LS1 applies on provision of the required resources; LS2 is the initial implementation baseline. Repeated positions remain separate source records, not mastery levels or new sport copies.
Actually synchronise movement with a partner and coordinate receiving/sending an object using visual/partner cues in a suitable modified activity.
A solo throw or a discussion about teamwork alone does not satisfy the physical coordination condition. Retain full locomotor, balance and object-control checks.
Follow or choose a suitable gradual warm-up and controlled comfortable mobility/stretching sequence for the intended activity. Leadership is not required.
Explain one choice, adjust when space/activity changes and stop or change an uncomfortable movement. Do not force range, pain or maximum effort.

NCERT source coverage requires the actual suitable preparation performance, without leadership or a verbal explanation prerequisite. Any broader canonical-card reason is checked separately and may be communicated by demonstration or picture choice; it is not an additional NCERT mandate.
Use existing mt_OTFABm2xdf without a new beat/dance topic: replicate a local chant/rhyme rhythm by clapping/tapping, keep its beat and join its repeated sound pattern at the appropriate moment.
Add purposeful stepping/body movement in the same supplied beat; use another piece to check transfer. Retain every canonical check and no fixed language or music-notation inventory.
The initial beat-node proposal was withdrawn after this complete existing-claim comparison. PE heading, body medium or older stage did not justify a clone.
